files._m_reexport_of_type_only.ts:
// SUPPORT for star-reexport-of-type-only.ts: re-exports what the module before it exports type-only.
export { v1 } from './_m_type_only_named';
files._m_type_only_named.ts:
// SUPPORT (not a probe): `export type { .. } from` of a value.
export type { v1 } from './_m_values';
files._m_type_star.ts:
// SUPPORT (not a probe): `export type *` of a module of values.
export type * from './_m_values';
files._m_type_star_as.ts:
// SUPPORT (not a probe): `export type * as ns` of a module of values.
export type * as tsNs from './_m_values';
files._m_type_star_mixed.ts:
// SUPPORT (not a probe): `export type *` of a module of types and values.
export type * from './_m_mixed';
files._m_types_aug.ts:
// SUPPORT (not a probe): only a type; augmented-star.ts adds a value with a module augmentation.
export type AugT = 1;
